India.label: India
India.headline: Nifty 50 and Sensex surge; Nifty up 2.01% to 25,030.35 and Sensex up 2.17% to 81,028.02 on strong foreign inflows, easing crude oil, robust bank earnings and a consumer‑durables ra
India.why: Multiple sources tie the gains to strong foreign inflows (including a notable FII comeback), easing crude‑oil prices, robust earnings from banks and a rally in consumer‑durables stocks. The Economic Times notes the bullish technical structure remains intact after the best weekly performance in five years, and Business Standard highlights the fiscal year ending on a high, providing broader market context.

drivers.label: Sensex, Nifty rally
drivers.detail: Business Standard explicitly links the same-direction market move to this factor in its market headline.

drivers.detail: BBN Times explicitly links the same-direction market move to this factor in its market headline.

drivers.label: Strong foreign inflows (FII comeback)
drivers.detail: India TV News and BBN Times both cite strong foreign institutional inflows as a primary catalyst for the rally.

drivers.label: Easing crude oil
drivers.detail: BBN Times attributes part of the market lift to lower crude‑oil prices, which reduce cost pressures for Indian companies.
